items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for bounded public beta or full launch; conditional for continued private preview. Recommendation: retain keep_private, reject sitemap, monetization expansion, and production changes. Evidence: searchwoot.com is password-gated, noindex/nofollow, and publicly observed as a private preview; SEO reports zero activity, while analytics and Data Hub are unavailable rather than zero. Compliance baseline is incomplete fleet-wide: 37 pass, 16 fail, 6 unknown; failures include missing cookie banner/accept/reject controls on 16 sites and missing privacy/terms evidence on 4 sites. This is technical triage, not legal certification. Human counsel is required for unresolved API/source rights, privacy and consent scope, consumer and affiliate disclosures, copyright/trademark use, platform policy, and any regulated or age-sensitive content decision. Incomplete telemetry alone does not block ordinary growth, but it is insufficient evidence for this gated public launch.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 legal tasks closed; all 4 remain open because no supporting evidence is present. Non-legal gates are also blocked: accuracy/freshness, measurement/attribution, and security/release. Next evidence action: attach the authoritative Woot API terms or written permission, field-level provenance, permitted caching/display/alert uses, attribution requirements, freshness limits, and correction/takedown process to searchwoot-legal-source-rights. Do not close the task until that evidence is recorded.

Data-use decisions for searchwoot.com: Woot API deal and price-history data—evidence_needed; missing current source terms or permission, field provenance, freshness/stale-data behavior, accuracy controls, correction/takedown process, and confirmed rights for public display, historical derivatives, images, trademarks, prices, savings claims, alerts, affiliate links, or advertising. Smallest next action: produce the owner-approved rights-and-data inventory. User alert rules and sync results—evidence_needed; missing field inventory, retention/deletion, access/correction workflow, Slack/email processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior. Smallest next action: produce a read-only data-flow and retention table. GA4 analytics—evidence_needed; missing deployed consent and withdrawal capture, property/data-sharing settings, retention, vendor disclosure, and jurisdiction treatment. Smallest next action: perform a read-only consent/configuration evidence capture without enabling tracking. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data—evidence_needed; missing log-field inventory, retention/access controls, vendor terms or DPA review, and incident/data-subject-request procedures. Smallest next action: produce the operator/vendor inventory and flag counsel-required gaps.

Revenue and attribution evidence does not support launch or monetization claims: Amazon reports $4.92 commission, 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, and 6 shipped items for 2026-09-21, but 629 clicks and all 28 ordered items are under tracking_id "other"; named site IDs show zero orders and commission. Analytics is unavailable for all 60 registry sites, so site-level revenue, margin, CAC, ROI, payback, and forecasts remain unsupported. No new tracking, affiliate configuration, advertising, or monetization proposal is recommended.

Risk disposition: blocked for bounded public beta or full launch; conditional for continued private preview. Retain keep_private pending source-rights, accuracy, privacy, consent, disclosure, security, attribution, margin, and rollback evidence. This is technical triage, not legal certification.
